module TopModule (
    input  in,
    input  state,
    output next_state,
    output out
);

    // State register
    reg [3:0] state_reg;

    // State transition logic
    always @(posedge state) begin
        case (state)
            4'b0001: begin
                state_reg <= 4'b0010; // B
            end
            4'b0010: begin
                state_reg <= 4'b0100; // C
            end
            4'b0100: begin
                state_reg <= 4'b0001; // A
            end
            4'b1000: begin
                state_reg <= 4'b0100; // C
            end
            default: begin
                state_reg <= state_reg; // No change
            end
        endcase
    end

    // Output logic
    assign next_state = state_reg;
    assign out = state_reg[3];

endmodule

module TopModule(
    input  in,
    input  state (4 bits),
    output next_state (4 bits),
    output out
);

always @(posedge state or posedge in) begin
    // State transition logic
    case (state)
        4'b0001: next_state = 4'b0010; out = 0; // A -> B
        4'b0010: next_state = 4'b0100; out = 0; // B -> C
        4'b0100: next_state = 4'b0001; out = 0; // C -> A
        4'b1000: next_state = 4'b0100; out = 1; // D -> C
    endcase

    // Output logic
    next_state <= state; // Invert the output to match the state transition
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input wire mode,
    input wire too_cold,
    input wire too_hot,
    input wire fan_on,
    output reg heater,
    output reg aircon,
    output reg fan
);

    // Heater and Air Conditioner states
    reg [1:0] state;

    // Fan on state
    reg fan_on_state;

    // Fan control
    always @(posedge mode or posedge fan_on) begin
        if (mode == 1) begin
            if (state == 0 || state == 2) begin
                state <= 1;  // Heater on
                fan_on_state <= 1; // Fan on
            end else begin
                state <= 0;  // Heater off
                fan_on_state <= 0; // Fan off
            end
        end else if (mode == 0) begin
            if (state == 1 || state == 2) begin
                state <= 0;  // Heater off
                fan_on_state <= 0; // Fan off
            end else begin
                state <= 2;  // Air Conditioner on
                fan_on_state <= 0; // Fan off
            end
        end else if (fan_on == 1) begin
            state <= 2;  // Air Conditioner on
            fan_on_state <= 1; // Fan on
        end else begin
            state <= 0;  // Heater off
            fan_on_state <= 0; // Fan off
        end
    end

    // Heater control
    always @(posedge state) begin
        if (state == 1) begin
            heater <= 1;  // Heater on
            aircon <= 0;  // Air Conditioner off
        end else if (state == 2) begin
            heater <= 0;  // Heater off
            aircon <= 1;  // Air Conditioner on
        end else begin
            heater <= 0;  // Heater off
            aircon <= 0;  // Air Conditioner off
        end
    end

    // Fan control
    always @(posedge fan_on_state) begin
        if (fan_on_state == 1) begin
            fan <= 1;  // Fan on
        end else begin
            fan <= 0;  // Fan off
        end
    end

endmodule

);

end

module TopModule (

    input resetn,
    input [1:0] byteena,
    input [15:0] d,
    output [15:0] q
);

reg [15:0] q_reg [0:15]; // Array of 16 DFFs

always @(posedge clk or negedge resetn) begin
    if (!resetn) begin
        q_reg <= 16'b0; // Reset all DFFs
    end else begin
        if (byteena[1]) begin // Write to upper byte (d[15:8])
            q_reg[0] <= d[15:8]; // Update the first DFF with the upper byte of d
            q_reg[1:15] <= q_reg[1:15]; // Leave the rest unchanged
        end else if (byteena[0]) begin // Write to lower byte (d[7:0])
            q_reg[0] <= q_reg[0]; // Leave the upper byte unchanged
            q_reg[1:15] <= d[7:0]; // Update the first DFF with the lower byte of d
        end else begin // Write to both bytes
            q_reg[0] <= d[7:0]; // Update the first DFF with both bytes
            q_reg[1:15] <= d[15:8]; // Update the first DFF with both bytes
        end
    end
end

assign q = q_reg[0]; // Output the first DFF as the result

endmodule

    input wire too_cold, // Temperature too cold
    input wire too_hot, // Temperature too hot
    input wire fan_on, // Request to turn on the fan
    output reg heater, // Heater control
    output reg aircon, // Air conditioner control
    output reg fan  // Fan control
);

    always @(mode, too_cold, too_hot, fan_on) begin

                heater <= 1'b1; // Heater on
                aircon <= 1'b0; // Air conditioner off
                fan <= fan_on; // Fan on if requested
            end else if (too_hot) begin
                heater <= 1'b0; // Heater off
                aircon <= 1'b1; // Air conditioner on
                fan <= fan_on; // Fan on if requested
            end else begin
                heater <= 1'b0; // Heater off
                aircon <= 1'b0; // Air conditioner off
                fan <= 1'b0; // Fan off
            end
        end else begin
            // Cooling mode
            if (too_cold) begin
                heater <= 1'b0; // Heater off
                aircon <= 1'b0; // Air conditioner off
                fan <= fan_on; // Fan on if requested
            end else if (too_hot) begin
                heater <= 1'b0; // Heater off
                aircon <= 1'b0; // Air conditioner off
                fan <= fan_on; // Fan on if requested
            end else begin
                heater <= 1'b0; // Heater off

);

module TopModule (
    input  a,
    input  b,
    input  c,
    input  d,
    input  e,
    output out
);

  // Intermediate output to keep track of the comparisons made
  reg [24:0] intermediate_output;

  // Main process to compute the 25 pairwise comparisons
  always @(*) begin
    intermediate_output = 0; // Initialize the output

    // Compute all pairwise comparisons
    intermediate_output[24] = ~a ^ a; // a == a -> 0
    intermediate_output[23] = ~a ^ b; // a == b -> 1
    intermediate_output[22] = ~a ^ c; // a == c -> 1
    intermediate_output[21] = ~a ^ d; // a == d -> 1
    intermediate_output[20] = ~a ^ e; // a == e -> 1
    intermediate_output[19] = ~b ^ a; // b == a -> 1
    intermediate_output[18] = ~b ^ b; // b == b -> 0
    intermediate_output[17] = ~b ^ c; // b == c -> 1
    intermediate_output[16] = ~b ^ d; // b == d -> 1
    intermediate_output[15] = ~b ^ e; // b == e -> 1
    intermediate_output[14] = ~c ^ a; // c == a -> 1
    intermediate_output[13] = ~c ^ b; // c == b -> 1
    intermediate_output[12] = ~c ^ c; // c == c -> 0
    intermediate_output[11] = ~c ^ d; // c == d -> 1
    intermediate_output[10] = ~c ^ e; // c == e -> 1
    intermediate_output[9] = ~d ^ a; // d == a -> 1
    intermediate_output[8] = ~d ^ b; // d == b -> 1
    intermediate_output[7] = ~d ^ c; // d == c -> 1
    intermediate_output[6] = ~d ^ d; // d == d -> 0
    intermediate_output[5] = ~d ^ e; // d == e -> 1
    intermediate_output[4] = ~e ^ a; // e == a -> 1
    intermediate_output[3] = ~e ^ b; // e == b -> 1
    intermediate_output[2] = ~e ^ c; // e == c -> 1
    intermediate_output[1] = ~e ^ d; // e == d -> 1
    intermediate_output[0] = ~e ^ e; // e == e -> 0
  end

  // Assign the intermediate output to the output port
  assign out = intermediate_output;

endmodule

    input w,     // input from the previous stage of the shift register
    input R,     // input to load value
    input E,     // enable shift
    input L,     // load value on L assertion
    output Q      // output of the shift register
);

    wire Q_out; // internal Q output to hold the shifted value

    // Synchronous process for shifting Q
    always @(posedge clk or posedge E or posedge R or posedge L) begin
        if (E) begin
            Q_out <= Q;
        end else if (R && L) begin
            Q_out <= Q; // Load value when L is asserted
        end else if (L) begin
            Q_out <= {Q[7:0], 1'b0}; // Shift right by 1 bit
        end else if (w) begin
            Q_out <= {Q, w}; // Add w to the leftmost bit of Q
        end else if (R) begin
            Q_out <= {Q, 1'b0}; // Shift right by 1 bit
        end else begin
            Q_out <= Q; // Copy Q to Q_out
        end
    end

    // Output Q
    assign Q = Q_out;

module TopModule
(
    input  clk,
    input  j,
    input  k,
    output Q
);

    // Define a register to hold the current state of the JK flip-flop
    reg Qold;

    // JK flip-flop logic
    always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
        if (~rst) begin
            Q <= 0; // Reset the flip-flop to 0
            Qold <= 0; // Reset the old state to 0
        end else begin
            Q <= (j && ~k) | (~j && k) ? 1 : Qold; // Update Q based on the JK input
            Qold <= Q; // Update the old state
        end
    end

module TopModule (
    input clk,
    input w,
    input R,
    input E,
    input L,
    output Q
);

    reg [31:0] shift_register [31:0]; // 32-bit shift register

    // Initial value of shift_register is 0
    initial shift_register[0] = 32'b0;

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (E) begin // Enable shift
            if (R) begin // Load value
                shift_register[31] = w; // Load value into the last bit
            end else if (L) begin // Load value from previous shift register
                shift_register[31] = shift_register[30];
            end else begin
                shift_register[0] = shift_register[0] << 1; // Shift left bit by one
                shift_register[31] = shift_register[31] | w; // Set the new bit
            end
        end else begin // Disable shift
            shift_register[0] <= 32'b0; // Clear the shift register
        end
    end

    assign Q = shift_register[0]; // Output the value of the shift register

endmodule

module TopModule (
    input mode,          // Control input to determine heating or cooling
    input too_cold,        // Input for too cold condition
    input too_hot,        // Input for too hot condition
    input fan_on,        // Input for requesting the fan to turn on
    output heater,       // Output for turning on the heater
    output aircon,      // Output for turning on the air conditioner
    output fan          // Output for turning on the fan
);

    // Internal signals to manage state transitions
    reg [1:0] state;
    reg fan_state;

    // State machine to determine heating, cooling, and fan actions
    always @(posedge mode or posedge fan_on or posedge too_cold or posedge too_hot) begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin  // State 0: Idle
                if (too_cold || fan_on) begin
                    state <= 2'b01;  // Transition to State 1: Heating or Fan
                end else begin
                    state <= 2'b00;  // Stay in State 0
                end
            end
            2'b01: begin  // State 1: Heating or Fan
                if (too_hot) begin
                    state <= 2'b10;  // Transition to State 2: Cooling
                end else begin
                    state <= 2'b01;  // Stay in State 1
                end
            end
            2'b10: begin  // State 2: Cooling
                if (fan_on) begin
                    state <= 2'b11;  // Transition to State 3: Fan On
                end else begin
                    state <= 2'b10;  // Stay in State 2
                end
            end
            2'b11: begin  // State 3: Fan On
                heater <= 1'b1;  // Turn on heater
                aircon <= 1'b0;  // Turn off air conditioner
                fan <= 1'b1;  // Turn on fan
            end
            default: begin
                state <= 2'b00;  // Default to Idle
            end
        endcase
    end

    // Assign outputs based on current state
    assign heater = (state == 2'b01) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
    assign aircon = (state == 2'b01) ? 1'b0 : 1'b1;
    assign fan = (state == 2'b11) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;
endmodule
